description: The full document for a Boxerbook document id: a boxer card, a bout (records, result, broadcasters, forecast, market, sources), a card with its bouts, or a division's rankings, as Markdown text with metadata. An unknown id returns an error. Pass lang matching the user's language (en, es, ru or ja) so the page links match it.

id.description: a document id: boxer:<id>, bout:<id>, event:<id> or rankings:<DIV>

lang.description: the user's language: en (default), es, ru or ja; the boxerbook.com page links of the answer follow it (a page without a translation keeps its English link)

name: fetch

metadata.description: type and ids of the document, plus source, license, attribution_url, as_of (and partial when part of the data could not be read)

text.description: the document as Markdown; its last line is the markdown link of its boxerbook.com page

title: Fetch a Boxerbook document
